label: Title Bar
behaviour: Spans the top 48 pixels of the maximised window frame, hosting the system menu, Quick Access Toolbar, document title, search box, account widget and window caption buttons.

label: Ribbon Tab Row
behaviour: Spans the 30-pixel strip beneath the title bar, hosting the File tab button, the main and contextual ribbon tabs, and the right-hand collaboration and mode controls.

label: Lower Ribbon
behaviour: Hosts the active ribbon tab's command groups and controls across a 100-pixel band beneath the tab row when Always show Ribbon is active.

label: Message Bar
behaviour: Appears directly below the ribbon as a 32-pixel banner when the document raises an information, warning, error or Protected View notice.

label: Document Area
behaviour: Occupies the central workspace between the ribbon (or message bar) and the status bar, shrinking horizontally when task panes dock on the left or right.

label: Task Pane Dock
behaviour: Hosts docked side panes at the right edge of the workspace between the ribbon and the status bar, defaulting to 320 pixels wide.

label: Status Bar
behaviour: Spans the bottom 22 pixels of the window frame, showing document indicators on the left and view and zoom controls on the right.

label: System
behaviour: Opens the window system menu with Restore, Move, Size, Minimize, Maximize and Close commands when clicked or triggered with Alt+Space.

label: Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Holds pinned one-click commands and the Customize Quick Access Toolbar drop-down on the left side of the title bar.

label: AutoSave
behaviour: Toggles automatic cloud saving for the active document when stored on a connected cloud drive.

label: Document Title
behaviour: Displays the active document name and save state and opens the rename and location flyout when clicked.

label: Window Caption
behaviour: Displays the document title and application name across the draggable title bar area and toggles maximise on double-click.

label: Search
behaviour: Focuses the title bar command and content search box (Alt+Q) and opens the search suggestions flyout.

label: Account
behaviour: Opens the account flyout showing the signed-in profile, account settings and sign-out controls.

label: Minimize
behaviour: Minimises the application window to the Windows taskbar.

label: Restore Down
behaviour: Restores a maximised window to its previous floating bounds or maximises a floating window, and shows Windows Snap Layouts on hover.

label: Close
behaviour: Closes the active application window, prompting to save unsaved changes before exiting.

label: AutoSave
behaviour: Toggles continuous background saving of the active document in the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Save
behaviour: Saves the active document immediately or opens the Save As page when the document has not yet been saved to disk.

label: Undo
behaviour: Reverses the last editing action on click or opens the history of recent actions to undo several steps at once.

label: More Options
behaviour: Opens the chronological list of recent editing actions so multiple actions can be undone together.

label: Repeat
behaviour: Repeats the last editing command or redoes the most recently undone action.

label: Customize Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Opens the menu to toggle common Quick Access Toolbar buttons, open the full command customiser, move the toolbar below the ribbon or hide it.

label: Automatically Save
behaviour: Shows or hides the AutoSave toggle switch on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: New
behaviour: Shows or hides the New Blank Document button on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Open
behaviour: Shows or hides the Open button on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Save
behaviour: Shows or hides the Save button on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Email
behaviour: Shows or hides the Email attachment button on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Quick Print
behaviour: Shows or hides the Quick Print button that sends the document directly to the default printer.

label: Print Preview and Print
behaviour: Shows or hides the Print Preview and Print button on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Editor (F7)
behaviour: Shows or hides the Editor proofing command on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Read Aloud
behaviour: Shows or hides the Read Aloud speech command on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Undo
behaviour: Shows or hides the Undo split button on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Redo
behaviour: Shows or hides the Redo or Repeat button on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Draw Table
behaviour: Shows or hides the Draw Table pen tool on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Touch/Mouse Mode
behaviour: Shows or hides the Touch or Mouse Mode spacing selector on the Quick Access Toolbar.

label: More Commands...
behaviour: Opens the Options dialog to the Quick Access Toolbar page for adding, removing or reordering any command.

label: Show Below the Ribbon
behaviour: Moves the Quick Access Toolbar from the title bar to a dedicated strip directly below the ribbon.

label: Hide Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Hides the Quick Access Toolbar from the window frame until re-enabled from Ribbon Display Options or Options.

label: File Tab
behaviour: Opens the full-window Backstage view for file management, printing, sharing, account settings and application options.

label: Ribbon Tabs
behaviour: Contains the ordered core and contextual tab headers along the tab row.

label: Comments
behaviour: Toggles the document Comments pane for viewing, replying to and resolving review threads.

label: Editing
behaviour: Opens the document access mode selector to switch between Editing, Reviewing (track changes) and Viewing (read-only).

label: Editing
behaviour: Allows direct changes to the document content and formatting without forcing tracked revisions.

label: Reviewing
behaviour: Restricts edits to tracked insertions, deletions and comments so others can review suggested changes.

label: Viewing
behaviour: Locks the document against accidental edits so it can be read without modifying content.

label: Share
behaviour: Opens the sharing menu to invite collaborators, copy a sharing link or manage access permissions.

label: Share...
behaviour: Opens the Share dialog to send the document or invite people to collaborate.

label: Copy Link...
behaviour: Generates and copies a link to the document into the clipboard.

label: Manage Access...
behaviour: Opens the permissions view to review or revoke who can view or edit the document.

label: Ribbon Display Options
behaviour: Opens the menu at the bottom-right corner of the lower ribbon to control ribbon visibility and Quick Access Toolbar visibility.

label: Full-screen mode
behaviour: Hides both the ribbon and the tab row to maximise document space, revealing them temporarily when the top of the window is clicked.

label: Show tabs only
behaviour: Collapses the lower ribbon so only the tab row stays visible, opening a tab's commands as a popup when clicked.

label: Always show Ribbon
behaviour: Pins both the tab row and the full lower ribbon open above the document workspace.

label: Hide Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Toggles visibility of the Quick Access Toolbar (reading Show Quick Access Toolbar when the toolbar is currently hidden).

label: Search Input
behaviour: Accepts text queries (Alt+Q) to search commands, document text, help topics and connected files.

label: Voice Search
behaviour: Starts microphone dictation into the search box to find commands or content by voice.

label: Search Flyout
behaviour: Displays categorised command, document, people, file and help results beneath the title bar search box.

label: Recently Used Actions
behaviour: Lists the commands most recently invoked from the search box for one-click reuse.

label: Suggested Actions
behaviour: Lists contextually relevant commands when the search box is first opened before typing a query.

label: Spelling and Grammar
behaviour: Runs the spelling and grammar checker on the active document from the default Suggested Actions list.

label: Word Count
behaviour: Opens the Word Count statistics dialog from the default Suggested Actions list.

label: Print
behaviour: Opens the Backstage Print page from the default Suggested Actions list.

label: People
behaviour: Lists collaborators and contacts matching the search query without exposing personal identities in the static inventory.

label: Actions
behaviour: Lists matching application commands and menus with direct execution and nested submenus as the user types.

label: Find in Document
behaviour: Searches the active document's text for the typed query and jumps to matching occurrences.

label: Files
behaviour: Lists recent and cloud documents whose titles or contents match the search query.

label: Help
behaviour: Lists documentation and help articles matching the search query.

label: KeyTips Layer
behaviour: Overlays alphanumeric keyboard access badges across the title bar and ribbon tab row when Alt or F10 is pressed and released.

label: AutoSave KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers the AutoSave toggle on the Quick Access Toolbar when 1 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Save KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers the Save command on the Quick Access Toolbar when 2 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Undo KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers the Undo command on the Quick Access Toolbar when 3 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Redo KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers the Repeat or Redo command on the Quick Access Toolbar when 4 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Document Title KeyTip
behaviour: Opens the document title and file location flyout when B is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Search KeyTip
behaviour: Focuses the title bar search box when Q is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Account KeyTip
behaviour: Opens the Account flyout when Z then P is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: File KeyTip
behaviour: Opens the Backstage view when F is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Comments KeyTip
behaviour: Toggles the Comments pane when Z then C is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Editing Mode KeyTip
behaviour: Opens the Editing, Reviewing and Viewing mode menu when Z then M is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Share KeyTip
behaviour: Opens the Share menu when Z then S is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Backstage Frame
behaviour: Replaces the ribbon and document workspace with the full-window File Backstage view when the File tab is activated.

label: Backstage Title Bar
behaviour: Spans the top 48 pixels of the Backstage view, keeping the document title and window caption buttons accessible.

label: Backstage Navigation Bar
behaviour: Spans a 160-pixel vertical rail on the left side of the Backstage view, hosting the Back button and page navigation tabs.

label: File Navigation List
behaviour: Lists the Backstage pages (Home, New, Open, Info, Save, Print, Share, Export, Transform, Close, Account, Feedback, Options) in the left rail.

label: Back
behaviour: Closes the Backstage view and returns focus to the active document and ribbon (also triggered by Escape).

label: Backstage Content Area
behaviour: Occupies the 1760-pixel area to the right of the Backstage navigation rail, rendering the selected Backstage page.

label: Status Bar Frame
behaviour: Hosts the status bar controls across the bottom 22-pixel strip of the window frame.

label: Status Bar Left Zone
behaviour: Hosts document-state indicators (page number, word count, proofing state, macro recording, accessibility status) aligned to the left edge.

label: Status Bar Right Zone
behaviour: Hosts display settings, view switchers and zoom controls aligned to the right edge of the status bar.

label: Display Settings
behaviour: Opens display and multi-monitor rendering options from the right zone of the status bar when present.

label: View Switcher
behaviour: Holds the quick view-mode toggle buttons (such as Read Mode, Print Layout and Web Layout) on the right side of the status bar.

label: Zoom Out
behaviour: Decreases the active document zoom level in 10 percent steps.

label: Zoom
behaviour: Drags the document magnification continuously between the minimum and maximum zoom percentages.

label: Zoom In
behaviour: Increases the active document zoom level in 10 percent steps.

label: Zoom 100%
behaviour: Displays the current zoom percentage and opens the Zoom dialog when clicked.

label: Customize Status Bar
behaviour: Opens on right-clicking the status bar to toggle which indicators, aggregates, view buttons and zoom controls are shown.

label: Book1 - Excel
behaviour: Displays the active workbook name and Excel application title across the title bar caption area.

label: Redo
behaviour: Redoes the last undone workbook edit or opens the redo history list as a split button on Excel's Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Excel Ribbon Tab Row
behaviour: Spans the 30-pixel tab row in Excel, hosting File, Ribbon Tabs, Comments and Share while omitting Word's Editing mode drop-down.

label: File Tab
behaviour: Opens the Excel Backstage view for workbook management, printing, sharing and options.

label: Ribbon Tabs
behaviour: Contains Excel's core and contextual ribbon tabs along the tab row.

label: Comments
behaviour: Toggles the workbook Comments pane on the right side of the tab row.

label: Share
behaviour: Opens the workbook Share menu on the right end of Excel's tab row.

label: PowerPoint Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Holds AutoSave, Save, Undo, Repeat, Start From Beginning and Customize Quick Access Toolbar in PowerPoint's title bar.

label: AutoSave
behaviour: Toggles automatic cloud saving for the active presentation on PowerPoint's Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Save
behaviour: Saves the active presentation from PowerPoint's Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Undo
behaviour: Undoes the last presentation action or opens the undo history drop-down.

label: Repeat
behaviour: Repeats or redoes the last presentation action.

label: Start From Beginning
behaviour: Starts the slide show from the first slide in the presentation (F5) directly from PowerPoint's default Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Customize Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Opens the Quick Access Toolbar customisation menu in PowerPoint.

label: Presentation1 - PowerPoint
behaviour: Displays the active presentation name and PowerPoint application title in the title bar.

label: PowerPoint Ribbon Tab Row
behaviour: Spans the 30-pixel tab row in PowerPoint, hosting File, Ribbon Tabs, Comments, Present in Teams and Share.

label: File Tab
behaviour: Opens the PowerPoint Backstage view.

label: Ribbon Tabs
behaviour: Contains PowerPoint's core and contextual ribbon tabs.

label: Comments
behaviour: Toggles the presentation Comments pane from PowerPoint's tab row.

label: Present in Teams
behaviour: Shares the active presentation directly into a live Microsoft Teams meeting from PowerPoint's tab row.

label: Share
behaviour: Opens the presentation Share menu on the right end of PowerPoint's tab row.

label: Start From Beginning KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Start From Beginning on PowerPoint's Quick Access Toolbar when 5 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Present in Teams KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Present in Teams on PowerPoint's tab row when Z then T is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Visio Title Bar
behaviour: Spans the top 48 pixels of Visio's window frame without an AutoSave switch.

label: System
behaviour: Opens Visio's window system menu.

label: Visio Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Holds Save, Undo, Redo and Customize Quick Access Toolbar in Visio's title bar without AutoSave.

label: Save
behaviour: Saves the active Visio drawing (Ctrl+S).

label: Undo
behaviour: Undoes the last drawing action or opens the undo history drop-down in Visio.

label: Redo
behaviour: Redoes the last undone drawing action in Visio.

label: Customize Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Opens the Quick Access Toolbar customisation menu in Visio.

label: Drawing1 - Visio Professional
behaviour: Displays the active drawing name and Visio product title across the title bar.

label: Search
behaviour: Focuses Visio's title bar search box (Alt+Q).

label: Account
behaviour: Opens the Account flyout in Visio's title bar.

label: Minimize
behaviour: Minimises the Visio window.

label: Restore Down
behaviour: Restores or maximises the Visio window.

label: Close
behaviour: Closes the Visio application window.

label: Visio Ribbon Tab Row
behaviour: Spans the 30-pixel tab row in Visio, hosting File, Ribbon Tabs, Comments, a direct Share... button and an MDI Close Document button.

label: File Tab
behaviour: Opens the Visio Backstage view.

label: Ribbon Tabs
behaviour: Contains Visio's core and contextual ribbon tabs.

label: Comments
behaviour: Toggles the diagram Comments pane in Visio.

label: Share...
behaviour: Opens the Share dialog directly as a push button on Visio's tab row.

label: Close
behaviour: Closes the active MDI drawing document window on the right end of Visio's tab row without exiting Visio.

label: Save KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Save on Visio's Quick Access Toolbar when 1 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Undo KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Undo on Visio's Quick Access Toolbar when 2 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Redo KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Redo on Visio's Quick Access Toolbar when 3 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Project Title Bar
behaviour: Spans the top 48 pixels of Project's window frame without AutoSave and without the title bar search box (which sits on the tab row in Project).

label: System
behaviour: Opens Project's window system menu.

label: Project Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Holds Save, Undo, Redo and Customize Quick Access Toolbar on the left side of Project's title bar.

label: Save
behaviour: Saves the active project schedule from Project's Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Undo
behaviour: Undoes the last schedule edit or opens the undo history drop-down in Project.

label: Redo
behaviour: Redoes the last undone schedule edit as a split button on Project's Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Customize Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Opens the Quick Access Toolbar customisation menu in Project.

label: Project Professional
behaviour: Displays the active project name and Project Professional title across the title bar.

label: Account
behaviour: Opens the Account flyout in Project's title bar.

label: Minimize
behaviour: Minimises the Project window.

label: Restore Down
behaviour: Restores or maximises the Project window.

label: Close
behaviour: Closes the Project application window.

label: Project Ribbon Tab Row
behaviour: Spans the 30-pixel tab row in Project, hosting File, Ribbon Tabs and the inline Tell Me search box after the Help tab.

label: File Tab
behaviour: Opens the Project Backstage view.

label: Ribbon Tabs
behaviour: Contains Project's core and contextual ribbon tabs (Task, Resource, Report, Project, View, Help, Task Form).

label: Tell me what you want to do
behaviour: Focuses the Tell Me command search box placed inline on Project's tab row immediately to the right of the Help tab.

label: Save KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Save on Project's Quick Access Toolbar when 1 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Undo KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Undo on Project's Quick Access Toolbar when 2 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Redo KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Redo on Project's Quick Access Toolbar when 3 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Search KeyTip
behaviour: Focuses Project's tab-row Tell Me search box when Q is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Outlook Explorer Title Bar
behaviour: Hosts the system menu, explorer Quick Access Toolbar, module caption, search box, account widget and window caption buttons in classic Outlook's main window.

label: System
behaviour: Opens classic Outlook's explorer window system menu.

label: Outlook Explorer Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Holds Send/Receive All Folders, Undo, Simplified Ribbon toggle, Minimize the Ribbon and Find a Contact in classic Outlook's explorer window.

label: Send/Receive All Folders
behaviour: Synchronises all mail, calendar and contact folders with connected mail servers from Outlook's explorer Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Undo
behaviour: Reverses the last folder or item action in Outlook's explorer window.

label: Simplified Ribbon
behaviour: Toggles the explorer ribbon between the three-row Classic layout and the single-line Simplified layout.

label: Minimize the Ribbon
behaviour: Collapses or expands the ribbon in Outlook's explorer window.

label: Find a Contact
behaviour: Searches the address book for a contact directly from Outlook's explorer Quick Access Toolbar.

label: Inbox - Outlook
behaviour: Displays the active folder name and Outlook title across the explorer title bar.

label: Search
behaviour: Focuses classic Outlook's title bar search box for mail, calendar, contacts and commands.

label: Account
behaviour: Opens the Account flyout in classic Outlook's explorer title bar.

label: Minimize
behaviour: Minimises the classic Outlook explorer window.

label: Restore Down
behaviour: Restores or maximises the classic Outlook explorer window.

label: Close
behaviour: Closes the classic Outlook explorer window.

label: Outlook Explorer Ribbon Tab Row
behaviour: Hosts the File tab and module ribbon tabs across classic Outlook's explorer tab row.

label: File Tab
behaviour: Opens the classic Outlook Backstage view.

label: Ribbon Tabs
behaviour: Contains classic Outlook's explorer module and contextual ribbon tabs.

label: Send/Receive All Folders KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Send/Receive All Folders on Outlook's explorer Quick Access Toolbar when 1 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Undo KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Undo on Outlook's explorer Quick Access Toolbar when 2 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Outlook Item Window Title Bar
behaviour: Hosts the system menu, item-window Quick Access Toolbar, item subject caption, search box, account widget and caption buttons in classic Outlook inspector windows.

label: System
behaviour: Opens the classic Outlook item window system menu.

label: Outlook Item Window Quick Access Toolbar
behaviour: Holds Save, Undo, Redo, Simplified Ribbon toggle and Minimize the Ribbon in classic Outlook item windows.

label: Save
behaviour: Saves the open mail draft, appointment, contact or task in Outlook's item window.

label: Undo
behaviour: Undoes the last editing action inside the Outlook item window.

label: Redo
behaviour: Redoes the last undone editing action inside the Outlook item window.

label: Simplified Ribbon
behaviour: Toggles the item window's ribbon between the Classic layout and the single-line Simplified layout.

label: Minimize the Ribbon
behaviour: Collapses or expands the ribbon inside the Outlook item window.

label: Untitled - Message (HTML)
behaviour: Displays the active item subject and message format across the Outlook inspector title bar.

label: Search
behaviour: Focuses the search box inside the classic Outlook item window.

label: Account
behaviour: Opens the Account flyout in the classic Outlook item window title bar.

label: Minimize
behaviour: Minimises the classic Outlook item window.

label: Restore Down
behaviour: Restores or maximises the classic Outlook item window.

label: Close
behaviour: Closes the classic Outlook item window.

label: Outlook Item Window Ribbon Tab Row
behaviour: Hosts the File tab and inspector ribbon tabs across classic Outlook's item window tab row.

label: File Tab
behaviour: Opens the classic Outlook item window Backstage view.

label: Ribbon Tabs
behaviour: Contains classic Outlook's item window core and contextual ribbon tabs.

label: Save KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Save on Outlook's item window Quick Access Toolbar when 1 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Undo KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Undo on Outlook's item window Quick Access Toolbar when 2 is pressed in KeyTip mode.

label: Redo KeyTip
behaviour: Triggers Redo on Outlook's item window Quick Access Toolbar when 3 is pressed in KeyTip mode.
